title: How much does a PADI diving course cost in Hurghada in 2026?
body_markdown:
There is no single PADI diving course cost in Hurghada for 2026. Your total depends on which program you choose and what the dive center includes. Compare written quotes for the same program, and check whether learning materials, equipment, training dives, certification processing and transfers are included.


**TL;DR**

- PADI course Hurghada cost has no single 2026 figure; compare itemized quotes for the same program.
- PADI Open Water Diver leads to certification; Discover Scuba Diving is an introduction, not a certification course.
- Daily Red Sea is best for travelers seeking a Hurghada scuba excursion, not an assumed certification package.
- Check learning materials, equipment, training dives and transfers before judging a course quote.


## How much does a PADI diving course cost in Hurghada in 2026?

**The answer is the total on an itemized quote for your chosen program, not a generic Hurghada course rate.** No verified 2026 amount is available here for a specific dive center or course. Ask each center to identify the program by name and list what you will pay for separately before you compare offers.

| Program | Best for | What you are buying | What to check in the quote |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| PADI Discover Scuba Diving | Travelers who want a supervised introduction | A diving experience, not an Open Water Diver certification | Whether equipment, instruction, the dive and transport are included |
| PADI Open Water Diver | Beginners seeking an entry-level scuba certification | Knowledge development, confined-water practice and open-water training dives | Whether learning materials, equipment, all required dives and certification processing are included |
| PADI Advanced Open Water Diver | Certified divers seeking further training | Adventure dives that build on an entry-level certification | Which dives are scheduled, what equipment they require and what the quote includes |

**Do not compare Discover Scuba Diving with Open Water Diver as though they award the same result.** One is an introduction; the other is a certification course. Likewise, an Advanced Open Water Diver quote answers a different question from a beginner's Open Water Diver quote.

The clearest request to send a dive center is: *Please quote the full cost of PADI Open Water Diver in Hurghada for my travel dates, with every included item and every required extra listed separately.* Replace the program name if you want a different course. A written response gives you something specific to compare without assuming that similarly named offers cover the same activities.

## Why this matters

A scuba excursion and a scuba certification course solve different problems. Daily Red Sea offers Hurghada scuba diving excursions; that description alone does not establish that any particular excursion includes PADI training or certification. If you want a day on the water rather than a qualification, compare the experience on the [Daily Red Sea website](https://dailyredsea.com/) with course options on its own terms.

If your goal is certification, make that clear before discussing boat schedules or reef locations. A scenic dive does not replace the required training components of a PADI course. If your goal is simply to try scuba while visiting Hurghada, ask about an introductory experience instead of paying for a course you do not intend to complete.

Your 2026 travel schedule matters as much as the quoted total. A course requires time for its learning and in-water components; an excursion is a different booking. Tell the dive center your arrival and departure dates so it can say whether the training fits your stay. Do not treat a reserved boat day as confirmation that your course requirements are covered.

## Which PADI option are you pricing?

Start with the outcome you want. The program name determines what belongs in the quote, what you need to complete and what you receive at the end. If a listing says only *scuba course*, ask for the exact PADI program name before evaluating its cost.


![Comparison of a supervised scuba introduction, entry-level certification and further training](https://gwvckixiegkllthleuyt.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/workspace-article-images-public/d4d90df3-af91-4f86-9b28-42b1ef671b1a/body-23a807a5036cbd688498fcccbd4b5065.jpg)

*Choose the outcome first; then compare quotes for that specific program.*


### Discover Scuba Diving: best for trying scuba

PADI Discover Scuba Diving is an introduction to scuba under professional supervision. It is **not an Open Water Diver certification**. Ask what the experience includes and what happens if you decide later to pursue a full course; do not assume the introduction itself gives you a certification card.

This distinction prevents the most basic comparison error. An introductory dive and a certification course can both involve equipment and an instructor, but they have different outcomes. Choose the introduction if your 2026 Hurghada trip is about trying diving, not qualifying for independent recreational dives.

### Open Water Diver: best for a first certification

PADI Open Water Diver is the entry-level certification course to request if you want to learn scuba diving. PADI's published course structure includes **5 confined-water dives and 4 open-water training dives**, alongside knowledge development. Confirm how the center schedules those components and whether the quoted total covers everything needed to complete them.

Ask what happens if you arrive having already completed a learning component. The answer should distinguish what remains to be done in Hurghada from what has already been completed. Do not assume a shorter on-site schedule changes the certification requirements or automatically changes the quoted total.

### Advanced Open Water Diver: best for certified divers

PADI Advanced Open Water Diver builds on an entry-level certification and includes **5 adventure dives**. It is not a substitute for Open Water Diver if you have never earned an entry-level scuba certification. State your existing qualification when asking for a quote so the center can identify the appropriate program.

Ask which adventure dives are planned and whether any need equipment beyond what the standard quote includes. You are comparing training content as well as cost. A schedule that does not fit your interests is not the right choice merely because its headline total looks simpler.

## Why PADI course costs vary in Hurghada

**Ask each dive center to account for these items in writing.** The list is a comparison checklist, not a claim that every center charges for them separately:

- **Course level:** Discover Scuba Diving, Open Water Diver and Advanced Open Water Diver have different training goals. Compare like with like.
- **Learning materials:** Check whether required study materials or digital learning access are part of the quoted total.
- **Equipment:** Ask which items are provided for training and whether anything you need is excluded.
- **Training dives:** Confirm that the quote covers every required in-water component for the named course, not just a sample itinerary.
- **Certification processing:** Ask whether the steps needed to receive your certification are included after you complete the course.
- **Transport and boat arrangements:** Check whether hotel pickup and travel to training locations are included, and confirm where you need to meet.

These questions identify the gap between a headline quote and your actual booking decision. If a center cannot explain an item, ask for clarification before paying. A lower-looking quote tells you little until you know what it covers.

## How do you compare 2026 quotes without missing a required item?

Send the same request to each dive center. Keep the program name, travel dates, number of participants and questions identical; otherwise, you are asking centers to price different trips. Then compare their written answers item by item.

1. **Name the program.** Specify Discover Scuba Diving, Open Water Diver or Advanced Open Water Diver rather than saying only *diving course*.
2. **State your starting point.** Say whether you are a first-time diver, have completed any learning, or already hold a scuba certification.
3. **Give your available dates.** Ask the center to show when the learning and in-water components take place during your Hurghada stay.
4. **Request a complete inclusion list.** Ask about materials, equipment, training dives, certification processing, boats and pickup.
5. **Ask for exclusions in writing.** If an item is not covered, the center should identify it before you decide.
6. **Confirm the completion plan.** Ask what you will have finished by the end of the scheduled training and what remains if you cannot complete it during this trip.

A quote that answers all these questions is more useful than a headline rate without a course outline. Keep the written response with your booking details. It gives you a shared reference if the schedule or inclusions need clarification later.

**Daily Red Sea is best for travelers seeking a Hurghada scuba excursion, not an assumed certification package.** If you are weighing an excursion against a course, decide whether you want the experience or the qualification first. That choice changes which questions you need to ask.

## Can you take a short diving trip instead of a PADI course?

**Yes, if your goal is an experience rather than certification.** Daily Red Sea offers scuba diving excursions in Hurghada, but an excursion must not be presented as a PADI course without confirmation of the specific training program. Ask what the trip involves and whether it is suitable for your current diving experience.

A short trip also works differently from a course in your calendar. With a course, you need to account for study, skills practice and the required training dives. With an excursion, you are choosing a particular outing. Neither option is automatically better: the right one depends on what you want to do after the trip ends.

If you already hold a certification, tell the operator which qualification you have. If you do not, say so before booking a dive. That lets you discuss an appropriate experience rather than assuming every advertised diving trip is open to every traveler.

## What should you confirm before paying for a course?

Check the written course name, scheduled components and total inclusions one final time. Ask who provides the training, what you need to complete before arrival and what you need to bring. Do not infer any of those details from a page about snorkeling, a reef trip or a general scuba excursion.

Make your 2026 travel dates part of the final confirmation. Ask the center to identify when you will complete the learning, confined-water practice and open-water dives if you are booking Open Water Diver. If a schedule changes, get the revised plan in writing so you know which components are still outstanding.

Also separate course completion from sightseeing plans. If you want an island boat trip or snorkeling day alongside your training, schedule it as its own activity rather than treating it as a required course dive. This keeps both the itinerary and the quote clear.

## Does Discover Scuba Diving cost the same as Open Water Diver?

**No direct cost comparison is meaningful without current quotes and a matching list of inclusions.** Discover Scuba Diving is an introductory experience; Open Water Diver is a certification course. Ask for the specific program you want, then check what its quote covers.

## How many training dives are in PADI Open Water Diver?

**PADI Open Water Diver includes 5 confined-water dives and 4 open-water training dives** in its published course structure. Ask the Hurghada dive center how those requirements appear on your schedule and whether every training component is included in its quote.

## Is Advanced Open Water Diver a beginner course?

**No. PADI Advanced Open Water Diver is further training for someone with an entry-level scuba certification.** It includes 5 adventure dives. If you are starting from scratch, ask about Open Water Diver instead.

## FAQ


**What is the PADI course Hurghada cost in 2026?**

There is no single 2026 cost that applies to every PADI course in Hurghada. Request an itemized quote for your chosen program and check materials, equipment, training dives, certification processing and transport.

**Which PADI course should I ask about as a complete beginner?**

Ask about PADI Open Water Diver if you want an entry-level scuba certification. If you only want to try diving, ask about Discover Scuba Diving instead; it is not a certification course.

**Is Discover Scuba Diving a PADI certification?**

No. PADI Discover Scuba Diving is a supervised introduction, not an Open Water Diver certification. Confirm the exact program name before you book.

**How many open-water dives does PADI Open Water Diver include?**

PADI Open Water Diver includes 4 open-water training dives. Its published course structure also includes 5 confined-water dives and knowledge development.

**Does a Hurghada scuba excursion include PADI certification?**

A scuba excursion does not establish that PADI certification is included. Ask whether the booking is a named certification course or a separate diving experience.

**Should equipment be included in a PADI course quote?**

Ask the dive center to state exactly which equipment its quote includes. Do not assume all centers list the same items in a headline course rate.

**Can I book Advanced Open Water Diver without a beginner certification?**

PADI Advanced Open Water Diver builds on an entry-level scuba certification. Tell the dive center what qualification you already hold so it can identify the right course.


## One last thing

The most useful 2026 cost question is not *What is your PADI course rate?* It is **What will I have completed, and what will I have paid for, when this booking ends?** That wording exposes the difference between an introduction, a certification course and a Daily Red Sea diving excursion before you commit to the wrong one.
